label: Bible Study
prompt: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is _____, being alone.
verse: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
note: James at his bluntest — faith without works isn't resting, it's dead.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst _____, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verse: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
note: A desperate father's 'if thou canst' gets turned right around — and he answers, 'help thou mine unbelief.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: Make thee an ark of _____ wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verse: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
note: Gopher wood appears exactly once in the Bible, and nobody is quite sure what tree it was.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
verse: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
note: God doesn't treat his people's deaths as statistics — each one is costly in his sight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be sober, be _____; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verse: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
note: 'Be sober, be vigilant' — written by Peter, who once fell asleep in Gethsemane when told to watch.
